not_found.reason: The segment note tables (t0155, t0156, t0157) report 'Additions to property, plant and equipment' only by segment and geography, with no single cell per reportable segment. Citing one would mean adding the U.S. and Non-U.S. cells. The parsed column headers are also corrupt: 'Specialty Products | Non-U.S.' appears twice, the total column is labelled 'Segment Total | Non-U.S.', and the U.S./Non-U.S. labels look swapped (the 2024 Pioneer-driven 94,649 sits under 'Upstream | Non-U.S.'). A segment-by-geography cell therefore cannot be cited reliably.

The segment note tables (t0155, t0156, t0157) show 'Sales and other operating revenue' and 'Segment revenues and other income' only by segment and geography, with no single cell per segment. Citing one would mean adding cells. The column headers are also corrupt: duplicated 'Specialty Products | Non-U.S.', a mislabelled total column, and apparently swapped U.S./Non-U.S. labels. Table t0158 splits revenue by ASC 606 scope, not by segment. Tables t0172 and t0173 are geographic results of producing activities, not segments.
No property, plant and equipment note with gross amounts by category is among the tables provided. Table t0060 gives only net 'Property, plant and equipment, less allowances'.
